phenotype_name: Severe Structural Upper Limb Reduction Deficiencies
matching_criterion_description: Transverse limb amputations, forearm aplasia, absent radius or ulna, and oligodactyly have a reported frequency of 0/18 in MAU2 series and <5% across all evaluations; presence strongly indicates classical NIPBL mutations.
Severe diaphragmatic hernias are absent (0/18) in MAU2 probands, making their detection a high clinical likelihood against CdLS7.
